method_notes: Method A: general web search; two English system2 queries, four explicit opens (three successful and one failed), no clicks/finds/reopens or alternate retrieval.

The start time marks the controlled search session, after reading the assignment. The assignment-file read occurred before its logging requirements were known; no retrospective timestamp was invented.
Model identity is only the inherited displayed parent label GPT-6 Astra Pro; immutable backend identity is not exposed.
The supplied input hash is recorded as supplied; this arm did not establish the original edition of the source opening post.
All 20 results from query 1 and 16 from query 2 are recorded in displayed order. Search previews are exposures, not direct reads.
Open events 3–5 were independent parallel calls, ordered by dispatch; each records its own actual UTC timestamps.
The failed open is charged. Remaining budget was not spent to fill a quota.

Only the assigned prompt was read locally before creating the assigned output. No source issue, sibling output, repository implementation, parent research, issue resolution, or later same-issue PR was inspected.
All design choices and tests are proposals. No implementation changes or behavioral tests were performed.

final_candidates.title: Flows : Node-RED
final_candidates.provider: Node-RED / OpenJS Foundation and Node-RED contributors
final_candidates.product_feature: Flow properties menu and tab entry points
final_candidates.version_or_date: Current unversioned guide read 2026-11-24; the 3.1.0 historical edition is unknown.
final_candidates.exact_section: Editing flow properties, lines 57–74 in the retrieved representation
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Directly read: the guide associates tab double-click with the flow-properties dialog and identifies the menu action as core:edit-flow. The dialog includes flow properties and environment-variable settings.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: The alternate documented entry point and existing action identifier supply a targeted regression comparison. The dialog and environment-variable capability are already in the supplied baseline.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Implement the requested caption change against the existing edit action; check the documentation's menu reference alongside the UI. This is a proposed implementation constraint, not a claim about source code.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed T1: create one flow named StableName with a flow-level variable CHECK_VALUE. Open its properties first through the renamed menu command and then by double-clicking the same tab; change only the variable through one route and reopen through the other.
final_candidates.expected_output: Under the requested fix, the menu caption communicates editing, both routes target the same flow and expose the variable setting, the variable edit persists, and the flow name remains StableName. A caption-only check would miss a wrong action binding or wrong flow target.
conditions_supported: The documentation supplies both routes and the existing action identifier.
The broader editor capability is explicitly baseline behavior, not a research invention.
limitations: No Node-RED 3.1.0 instance or repository implementation was inspected.
The current guide still shows the old menu caption; it cannot establish the current application's label or whether any fix shipped.
Route equivalence and persistence test are proposed, not executed.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: The guide retains the narrow menu wording, so it corroborates the documented mismatch rather than proving a solution or current product state.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown for this exact document edition at 2024-01-01. The input independently establishes the relevant dialog behavior in 3.1.0.

final_candidates.title: Fallback | i18next documentation
final_candidates.version_or_date: Current unversioned documentation representation read 2026-11-24; exact library version and historical edition unknown.
final_candidates.exact_section: Language fallback / Fallback to different languages; Key fallback / Key not found, retrieved lines 87–107 and 152–176
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Direct retrieval returned a tool-labeled rewritten summary after redirect. With fallback configured, a missing locale value can resolve through another language; exhausted lookup can display the key.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Adds a failure test for translation completeness: readable English after the rename does not establish that a requested non-English catalog contains the updated meaning. The original already requests translation changes.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Check the selected locale's own message entry in addition to rendered text. Use the application's actual localization mechanism; applying specific i18next configuration to Node-RED is conditional on verification.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed T2: in an isolated translation fixture, define the updated English caption and deliberately omit its entry in one supported non-English locale. Run the menu-label check under that locale with the actual fallback configuration.
final_candidates.expected_output: The translation-completeness check must fail despite any readable fallback caption; it should pass only when the selected locale supplies the intended edit meaning. Raw-key display is another failure. This distinguishes locale coverage from a nonempty-label smoke test.
conditions_supported: Fallback requires a configured resolution path; no particular Node-RED fallback configuration was verified.
The principle concerns catalog resolution, not proof that the Node-RED flow menu uses this library or these current defaults.
limitations: The Node-RED design-wiki open failed, leaving direct implementation linkage unknown.
The opened representation is explicitly a rewritten summary, not a pinned source edition.
Historical availability of the exact guidance at the request date is unknown.
The proposed fixture was not executed.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Search and opened representations disagree on which array fallback key is returned after total failure. The test does not depend on fallback-array order, empty-string defaults, or unverified version-specific defaults.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown for the retrieved edition and for the Node-RED 3.1.0 dependency/configuration.
